features.title: Runnable FastAPI + React skeleton with SQLite, OIDC stub, and one end-to-end workflow
acceptance: Backend FastAPI app starts and serves /api/health
Frontend Vite React app builds and serves
SQLite database with agents table created on startup
OIDC/Keycloak auth stub with demo mode
One complete workflow: create agent -> list agents -> get agent detail
Backend tests pass (pytest)
Frontend typecheck and build pass
Dockerfiles for backend and frontend

features.title: Strict agent workspace sandbox (issue #1160)
acceptance: Each agent confined to its own workspace directory
Cross-agent file operations return permission error
Path traversal attempts blocked

features.title: MCP tool exposure for agent memory system (issue #322)
acceptance: MCP server exposes agent memory tools
External AI can call tools via MCP protocol
Tools work independently of main UI

features.title: Defensive onnxruntime/fastembed loading for Windows compatibility (issue #2072)
acceptance: Startup preload of optional native deps
Graceful degradation on import failure
Documented Windows version requirements

features.title: PostgreSQL connection pool liveness checks (issue #1172)
acceptance: Connection pool configured with check= probe
Explicit max_lifetime configured
Retry logic for transient connection errors

features.title: LLM chat integration for agents (issue #NEW)
acceptance: AgentService.chat_with_llm method sends chat completions using agent's configured LLM
POST /api/agents/{id}/chat endpoint accepts messages and returns LLM response
Frontend API client includes chat types and send function
Error handling for missing agent, missing model config, invalid message roles
